surfaces.label: Shape model
surfaces.coverage: Released New Horizons contact-binary shape: two overlapping closed lobe meshes. Southern surface detail is constrained by flyby imagery; the unseen side is a source model estimate. Revised pole from the bundled Porter paper Table 2. Its PDS XML gives an inconsistent earlier pole; the paper pole is used with arbitrary meridian and no precision spin-phase claim. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

surfaces.label: Modeled albedo

projection.description: Two south polar azimuthal equidistant projections; source UVs identify each lobe.

surfaces.coverage: Published LORRI albedo fit in the released per-lobe OBJ UV mapping, shown with a grayscale stretch. The source retains a uniform baseline where imagery is unconstrained and supplies no observation-coverage mask; uniform areas must not be interpreted as measured albedo. This is a model map, not a global photograph.

scalarMap.registration: Released OBJ per-corner UVs; barycentric transfer from the selected closest full-source triangle, bounded in metres. No radial reprojection.
scalarMap.validity: Finite released values, with only explicitly authored no-data values withheld. This is not an observational coverage claim.

surfaceSampling.previewPolicy: Radial rays with more than one distinct source intersection are withheld; the triangle atlas samples the source surface in 3D.

transfer.method: Released OBJ per-corner UVs; barycentric transfer from the selected closest full-source triangle, bounded in metres. No radial reprojection.
